name: ab_3dgut_tune_drone_2k
notes: 3DGUT knobs on one cached map with deterministic=True (same seed, inline sampler, source localized before step 0), so n=1 per variant compares like for like; the noise floor is the det spread from ab_3dgut_det_drone_2k. ut_margin: sigma points may reach 50% (not 10%) beyond the image before a Gaussian is culled (the strict all-valid default culls large border Gaussians: popping); require_all stays on because lenient validity mixes behind-camera projections into the covariance. ut_alpha1: wider sigma-point spread (3DGRUT-style). closed_loop: variance-weighted depth + render-anchored realignment. noise_half: half the MCMC position noise.
